connector.name: MCP by replynodes
connector.registryDescription: Connect AI agents to Replynodes over the Model Context Protocol.
connector.summary: Hosted at app.replynodes.com over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the replynodes account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: REPLYNODES_API_KEY
env.description: Replynodes API key (Settings → API Keys in app.replynodes.com)
